{'雖然 iOS 27 推出備受矚目，不過 Apple 本月亦有為 AirPods 推送全新的軟件更新。是次更新為支援型號的 AirPods 帶來一項期待已久的功能：自訂 EQ。': 'While iOS 27 is the headline release this month, Apple has also rolled out a notable AirPods software update. The update brings a long-awaited feature to supported AirPods: a custom EQ.'}

{'AirPods 軟件詳情': 'AirPods software details'}

{'最新嘅 AirPods 韌體版本為 AirPods 5 嘅 9A350，以及下列其他型號嘅 9A348。以下 AirPods 型號符合更新資格：': 'The latest AirPods firmware version is 9A350 for AirPods 5, and 9A348 for the following other models. The following AirPods models are eligible for the update:'}

  • {'AirPods Pro 3': 'AirPods Pro 3'}
  • {'AirPods 4': 'AirPods 4'}
  • {'AirPods 4（主動降噪版）': 'AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation)'}
  • {'AirPods 5': 'AirPods 5'}
  • {'AirPods 5（配無線充電盒版）': 'AirPods 5 (Wireless Charging Case)'}
  • {'AirPods Pro 2（Lightning 及 USB-C 版本）': 'AirPods Pro 2 (Lightning and USB-C)'}
  • {'AirPods Max 2': 'AirPods Max 2'}

{'Apple 表示，只要 AirPods 正在充電，並處於已配對嘅 iPhone、iPad 或 Mac 嘅藍牙範圍內，而該裝置已連接 Wi-Fi，韌體更新便會自動安裝。你可以喺 iPhone 嘅「設定」App 內查看 AirPods 嘅韌體版本。': 'Apple says the firmware update will install automatically as long as the AirPods are charging, within Bluetooth range of a paired iPhone, iPad, or Mac, and that device is connected to Wi-Fi. You can check your AirPods firmware version in the Settings app on your iPhone.'}

{'自訂 EQ 登陸 AirPods': 'Custom EQ comes to AirPods'}

{'安裝 AirPods 韌體更新後，你可以喺「設定」App 內搵到呢個期待已久嘅新功能：自訂 EQ。': "After installing the AirPods firmware update, you'll find the long-awaited new feature in the Settings app: custom EQ."}

{'透過新增嘅自訂 EQ 控制項，你而家可以更靈活咁調整 AirPods 嘅音效設定。喺「設定」App 內，你可以手動調校 AirPods 嘅低音、中音及高音頻率。': 'With the new custom EQ controls, you now have more flexibility to fine-tune the sound of your AirPods. In the Settings app, you can manually adjust the bass, mid, and treble frequencies of your AirPods.'}

{'Apple 解釋：「AirPods 由 Apple 設計及打造，旨在忠實呈現音樂、電視節目及電影嘅音效，以及通話質素。如果你偏好唔同嘅音效設定，可以自訂 AirPods 播放任何音訊時嘅聲音表現。」': 'Apple explains: "AirPods are designed and engineered by Apple to faithfully reproduce the audio of music, TV shows, and movies, as well as the quality of phone calls. If you prefer a different sound profile, you can customize how AirPods sound when playing any audio."'}

{'調校自訂 EQ 設定時，你可以直接喺「設定」App 內播放 Apple Music 歌曲，即時聽到調整效果。': 'While adjusting custom EQ settings, you can play Apple Music songs directly within the Settings app to hear the effect of your changes in real time.'}

{'呢個唔係市面上最先進嘅均衡器功能——佢只係一個基本嘅三段式系統。不過，呢個係 AirPods 用戶等咗好耐嘅功能，Apple 終於肯提供——雖然大部分人可能仍然會用返預設設定。': "This isn't the most advanced equalizer on the market—it's just a basic three-band system. However, this is a feature AirPods users have waited a long time for, and Apple has finally delivered it—although most people will likely stick with the default settings."}

{'你可以喺「設定」App 內 AirPods 欄目下嘅「音訊與路由」選單入面搵到新嘅自訂 EQ 功能。呢個功能適用於所有配備 H2 晶片嘅 AirPods，包括 AirPods Pro 2、AirPods Pro 3、AirPods 4 及 AirPods Max 2。': 'You can find the new custom EQ feature in the Settings app under the AirPods section, within the "Audio & Routing" menu. This feature is available on all AirPods equipped with the H2 chip, including AirPods Pro 2, AirPods Pro 3, AirPods 4, and AirPods Max 2.'}

{'iOS 27 為 AirPods 帶嚟嘅其他功能': 'Other AirPods features in iOS 27'}

{'以下係 iOS 27 為 AirPods 帶嚟嘅其他新功能：': 'Here are the other new AirPods features coming in iOS 27:'}

  • {'重新設計嘅「設定」App：喺 iOS 27 入面，Apple 重新設計咗「設定」App 內嘅 AirPods 介面。各項控制項經過重新整理，將聽力健康、Find My、即時翻譯等功能分拆為獨立選單。': 'Redesigned Settings app: In iOS 27, Apple has redesigned the AirPods interface within the Settings app. The various controls have been reorganized, separating features like hearing health, Find My, and live translation into their own dedicated menus.'}
  • {'適應性音訊滑桿：「設定」App 內新增咗滑桿，可以進一步微調適應性音訊模式。': 'Adaptive Audio slider: A new slider has been added to the Settings app, allowing further fine-tuning of Adaptive Audio mode.'}
  • {'GymKit：雖然 GymKit 已經推出多年，但一直需要配合 Apple Watch 使用。正如我同事 Zac 所提到，iOS 27 將完整嘅 GymKit 體驗帶到 iPhone 及 AirPods Pro 3。': 'GymKit: Although GymKit has been around for years, it has always required an Apple Watch. As my colleague Zac noted, iOS 27 brings the full GymKit experience to iPhone and AirPods Pro 3.'}
  • {'精確尋找：你而家可以喺 Apple Watch 上嘅「Find My」App 使用精確尋找功能，定位你嘅 AirPods Pro 3。': 'Precision Finding: You can now use the Precision Finding feature in the Find My app on your Apple Watch to locate your AirPods Pro 3.'}
  • {'Siri AI：配合兼容嘅 iPhone 使用時，AirPods 可以同 Siri AI 互動。': 'Siri AI: When used with a compatible iPhone, AirPods can interact with Siri AI.'}

{'總結': 'Wrap up'}

{'你最期待試用邊項新嘅 AirPods 功能？你會唔會嘗試新嘅自訂 EQ 功能？歡迎喺留言區同我哋分享。': 'Which new AirPods feature are you most excited to try out? Will you give the new custom EQ a go? Let us know in the comments section below.'}

{'我最喜愛嘅 iPhone 18 Pro 配件': 'My favorite iPhone 18 Pro accessories'}

  • {'官方 Apple 護殼：矽膠、透明及 TechWoven': 'Official Apple cases: Silicone, Clear, and TechWoven'}
  • {'Apple iPhone 及 AirPods 手腕帶': 'Apple iPhone and AirPods wrist strap'}
  • {'Apple 40W 動態電源轉接器（最高 60W）': 'Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter (up to 60W)'}
  • {'內建 LED 顯示器嘅 USB-C 線': 'USB-C cable with built-in LED display'}
  • {'Beats 多色編織 USB-C 線': 'Beats multi-color braided USB-C cable'}

{'追蹤 Chance：Threads、Bluesky、Instagram 及 Mastodon。': 'Follow Chance: Threads, Bluesky, Instagram, and Mastodon.'}
